decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 4 April 2005, the erection of an outbuilding measuring 5.85 metres deep, 5.0 metres wide and 3.5 metres high was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because it is for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house and falls below the size limits set by the Order.
Condition : 2 - Informative:   

The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 100 Hinton Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in rear end of garden to house for use as a gamesroom/store
